newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's NTMK loses garnet development licence.
newsitem.headline: Russia's NTMK loses garnet development licence.

text.p: Russia's Sverdlovsk region has annulled the licence of the NTMK metals company to develop a garnet deposit, Itar-Tass quoted the head of the local geological committee as saying.
Vladimir Leshikov said a new tender would be held in the next two months for the right to develop the Bobrovsky deposit.

AO Nizhnetagilsky Metallurgichesky Kombinat (NTMK), located in Nizhny Tagil in the Ural mountains area, won a tender to develop it in 1993, but had since then reduced the financing allotted for exploration, Tass said.
